verdicts.reason: A breaks the original's reading order. The 'Try It' button is jammed directly under the product circle and nearly touches it, 'Out now.' hangs off the right side of the button as a stray fragment, and the small headline floats alone on the left above a large dead area. B keeps the original's structure: product on the left, then a left-aligned headline, subline and CTA with clear hierarchy and even spacing. Its only flaws are that the circle nearly touches the bottom edge and the headline runs close to the right edge.
